Report only defects with exact stage/id and source evidence. Return exact keys: verdict (PASS_SCOPED, CORRECTION_REQUIRED, or HOLD), candidate_sha256, findings (array of {stage,claim_id,decision,evidence,required_change}), scope_limit. Do not grant scientific/native/protected acceptance or assess other arms.
